About the job

Help Deliver the Future of Usage-Based Billing

LogiSense is looking for a Software Developer to help build and enhance our
usage-based billing platform. You'll bring strong C#, .NET, and Microsoft SQL
Server skills, along with experience applying other technologies to solve
problems. AI tools are part of your everyday development workflow, and you know
how to validate their results.

You'll work within a cross-functional sprint team and across the wider
organization to turn customer and business needs into reliable improvements to
the LogiSense Billing platform.

Our cloud-based billing and monetization platform helps innovative companies
automate and scale complex usage-based and subscription billing models.

The Role

As a Software Developer at LogiSense, you'll own complex features spanning
multiple application components, from design through delivery. You'll help
clarify requirements, make well-reasoned technical decisions, and work with QA
and other members of your Scrum team to address testing and regression risks.
Your ownership extends to supporting the software you deliver and improving its
reliability in collaboration with IT and Support.

You'll organize and prioritize your work with minimal supervision, provide
realistic estimates, and raise risks early. You'll know when to work through a
problem independently and when to involve others. Through pairing, reviews, and
knowledge sharing, you'll help colleagues grow while contributing improvements
to shared code and development practices.

What You'll Bring To The Team

- Strong experience developing enterprise applications with C# and .NET, plus
  experience applying other technologies to solve problems
- Strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server, including database design,
  T-SQL, and query optimization
- Experience with at least one of Node.js or a modern UI framework
- Practical experience incorporating AI tools into your everyday development
  workflow, understanding their limitations, validating their results, and
  sharing effective practices
- Experience designing, implementing, and integrating with RESTful APIs
- The ability to own complex features across multiple application components,
  from design through delivery, with minimal supervision
- The ability to break down requirements into development tasks, identify
  dependencies, provide realistic estimates, and communicate risks early
- Sound judgment in software design decisions and technical tradeoffs,
  including knowing when to involve others
- A systematic approach to debugging, performance profiling, and optimization
- Experience implementing automated unit and functional tests, and working
  with QA and other members of your Scrum team to address integration and
  regression risks
- The ability to work with Product and other stakeholders to understand user
  needs and clarify requirements, and communicate technical decisions through
  documentation, walkthroughs, and discussions
- The ability to develop a broad understanding of the LogiSense Billing
  platform and deep expertise in the components you support
- The ability to mentor teammates through pairing, design reviews, code
  reviews, and knowledge sharing
- A commitment to supporting and improving the reliability of the software you
  deliver, in collaboration with IT and Support
- Initiative to improve shared code, address technical debt, and strengthen
  development practices

Strongly Preferred

- Experience building, deploying, or supporting applications on AWS or another
  cloud platform
- Experience working within Scrum or another Agile development process
